Chinese AI Tools Used in Global Cyberattacks, Reports Indicate

Hackers have utilized a Chinese artificial intelligence tool to target South Korean banks, highlighting a new global cybersecurity risk. The AI tool, developed in China, is reportedly being adopted by factories there, indicating a rapid integration of advanced AI technologies into global industries. This development signals a growing concern over the potential misuse of AI in cyber warfare and financial system vulnerabilities.
